Merge upstream server and core changes

llama_cpp_advisories.title: GGUF mem_size integer-overflow validation bypass
llama_cpp_advisories.preconditions: Attacker-controlled GGUF reaches a path using allocation/parsing; highest relevance to quantize, imatrix, control-vector and GGUF tools using no_alloc=false.
llama_cpp_advisories.source_status: All requested core snapshots inspected contain the overflow/representability guard family; blobs diverge but semantics match.
llama_cpp_advisories.compile_runtime: GGUF parser is core code and normally compiled. Runtime reachability requires an operator or workflow to ingest the untrusted file.
llama_cpp_advisories.boundary: File/model supply-chain boundary; no listener required.
llama_cpp_advisories.test: In an isolated ASan/UBSan build, feed bounded synthetic headers at each arithmetic limit and require deterministic parse rejection before allocation; do not use public exploit files.
llama_cpp_advisories.action: No source backport identified for the candidate. Keep model ingestion untrusted and retain bounded parser tests.
llama_cpp_advisories.label: [MEASURED]

llama_cpp_advisories.title: RPC GRAPH_COMPUTE null-buffer validation bypass
llama_cpp_advisories.symbols: deserialize_tensor; create_node; client tensor serialization; GRAPH_COMPUTE command
llama_cpp_advisories.preconditions: RPC server built, launched, and reachable; unauthenticated protocol peer can submit graph metadata.
llama_cpp_advisories.source_status: All requested core snapshots inspected contain the corrected client data-zeroing and server buffer==nullptr/data!=nullptr rejection semantics. ROCm lineage and upstream/Cachy use different blobs.
llama_cpp_advisories.compile_runtime: Generic source default GGML_RPC=OFF, but ROCmFPX and predecessor release workflows explicitly pass -DGGML_RPC=ON. Runtime requires rpc-server launch.
llama_cpp_advisories.boundary: Unauthenticated raw TCP RPC listener; default loopback does not make it safe for untrusted networks.
llama_cpp_advisories.test: Use a disposable loopback-only RPC unit harness: a legitimate CPU-buffer graph must remain accepted, while an inconsistent null-buffer/nonzero-data descriptor must be rejected before graph construction. No live-service probing.
llama_cpp_advisories.action: Do not treat the patch as permission to expose RPC. Remove RPC from standard release artifacts; use ba38 semantics rather than the superseded emergency-only behavior.
llama_cpp_advisories.label: [MEASURED]

llama_cpp_advisories.title: GGUF tensor-size representability overflow
llama_cpp_advisories.preconditions: Untrusted GGUF with crafted dimensions is loaded.
llama_cpp_advisories.source_status: All requested core snapshots inspected contain tensor-size representability checks.
llama_cpp_advisories.compile_runtime: Core parser path; normally compiled and reachable during model or auxiliary GGUF ingestion.
llama_cpp_advisories.test: Generate only bounded dimension tuples around SIZE_MAX division boundaries in a unit seam; require rejection without allocation or wraparound under sanitizers.
llama_cpp_advisories.action: No candidate backport identified; retain source sentinel and sanitizer regression.
llama_cpp_advisories.label: [MEASURED]

llama_cpp_advisories.title: HTTP server negative n_discard out-of-bounds write
llama_cpp_advisories.preconditions: llama-server running; route reachable; context shift enabled; context full; negative n_discard supplied.
llama_cpp_advisories.source_status: ROCmFPX baseline/candidate and upstream source checks show the std::max(0, n_discard) clamp. Cachy inclusion is inferred from its later merged source snapshot.
llama_cpp_advisories.compile_runtime: ROCmFPX release builds include llama-server. The project launcher passes --no-context-shift, but other launch paths remain reachable.
llama_cpp_advisories.boundary: HTTP listener; unauthenticated when API-key set is empty.
llama_cpp_advisories.test: In a loopback-only tiny-model lab, fill context and send a negative n_discard through the normal API; require 4xx or clamped behavior, no sanitizer finding, and process survival.
llama_cpp_advisories.action: No candidate source backport identified. Enforce context-shift policy and authenticated loopback listener independently of this fix.
llama_cpp_advisories.label: [MEASURED]

llama_cpp_advisories.title: GGUF cumulative context-size overflow
llama_cpp_advisories.preconditions: Untrusted GGUF drives cumulative metadata/tensor-size arithmetic.
llama_cpp_advisories.source_status: All requested core snapshots inspected contain the cumulative-size checks.
llama_cpp_advisories.compile_runtime: Core parser; normally compiled and reached on file ingestion.
llama_cpp_advisories.test: Use bounded metadata sections whose individual sizes are valid but cumulative sum crosses the configured limit; require early rejection.
llama_cpp_advisories.label: [MEASURED]

llama_cpp_advisories.title: Tokenizer result-size signed/unsigned overflow
llama_cpp_advisories.preconditions: A prompt/template/tokenization result approaches or exceeds INT32_MAX; practical exploitation is resource-intensive but input can originate at HTTP/API boundaries.
llama_cpp_advisories.source_status: The ROCm, deployed-source, Cachy, and upstream vocab lineages contain the INT32_MAX result guard.
llama_cpp_advisories.compile_runtime: Tokenizer is core and reachable from CLI and HTTP request handling.
llama_cpp_advisories.boundary: Prompt/message/API boundary and local CLI input.
llama_cpp_advisories.test: Use a mocked tokenizer-result container reporting boundary sizes; require INT32_MIN/error without allocating multi-gigabyte memory.
llama_cpp_advisories.action: No candidate backport identified; keep a mock-based boundary test.
llama_cpp_advisories.label: [MEASURED]

llama_cpp_advisories.title: Vocabulary special-token heap over-read
llama_cpp_advisories.preconditions: Malicious or malformed GGUF has a vocabulary smaller than default/specified special-token IDs.
llama_cpp_advisories.source_status: All requested vocab lineages inspected use checked .at() access in the material print path.
llama_cpp_advisories.test: Load a tiny synthetic vocabulary with every special-token ID just outside range; require clean error handling, not an out-of-bounds access.
llama_cpp_advisories.action: No source backport identified. Record the official affected/patched metadata inconsistency in intake tooling.
llama_cpp_advisories.label: [MEASURED]

llama_cpp_advisories.title: token_to_piece size-conversion buffer overflow
llama_cpp_advisories.fix_refs: Security fix 3cfbbdb44e08fd19429fed6cc85b982a91f0efd5; build follow-up b5662 / fb85a288d72abbd5e5daa8de96e6f8bfa7b5ab46
llama_cpp_advisories.preconditions: Attacker-controlled token piece length exceeds signed 32-bit representation during vocabulary loading or token conversion.
llama_cpp_advisories.source_status: All requested vocab lineages inspected contain the INT32_MAX token-piece guard.
llama_cpp_advisories.boundary: File/model supply-chain boundary; output conversion can also be API-reachable after model load.
llama_cpp_advisories.test: Mock a token piece length at INT32_MAX and above; require error/abort through the documented error path before memcpy.
llama_cpp_advisories.action: No candidate backport identified. Track the security commit separately from the b5662 build-fix tag.
llama_cpp_advisories.label: [MEASURED]

llama_cpp_advisories.title: RPC SET_TENSOR arbitrary write
llama_cpp_advisories.preconditions: RPC server built, launched, reachable; unauthenticated peer sends out-of-range tensor metadata.
llama_cpp_advisories.source_status: All requested RPC lineages contain bounds/type/buffer validation introduced by and after b3561.
llama_cpp_advisories.compile_runtime: ROCm release workflows explicitly enable RPC; generic source default is off.
llama_cpp_advisories.test: Direct unit-test the handler with offsets one byte below, at, and above the destination buffer end; require rejection and unchanged guard bytes.
llama_cpp_advisories.action: No code backport identified; remove RPC from standard release and retain handler tests.
llama_cpp_advisories.label: [MEASURED]

llama_cpp_advisories.title: RPC GET_TENSOR arbitrary read
llama_cpp_advisories.preconditions: RPC server built, launched, and reachable.
llama_cpp_advisories.source_status: All requested RPC lineages contain the b3561-era read bounds checks and later null-buffer checks.
llama_cpp_advisories.compile_runtime: Release workflow inclusion makes the code present; listener launch determines reachability.
llama_cpp_advisories.test: Direct handler test with a source region crossing the buffer end; require rejection and zero response payload.
llama_cpp_advisories.action: No code backport identified; deny RPC by build policy.
llama_cpp_advisories.label: [MEASURED]

llama_cpp_advisories.title: RPC invalid tensor type global buffer overflow
llama_cpp_advisories.symbols: RPC tensor deserialization; ggml_type and block-size validation
llama_cpp_advisories.preconditions: RPC server built, launched, reachable; peer supplies invalid/deprecated type.
llama_cpp_advisories.source_status: All requested RPC lineages contain type range/block-size checks, including the later zero-block-size patch.
llama_cpp_advisories.compile_runtime: Same RPC inclusion/reachability conditions as other RPC advisories.
llama_cpp_advisories.test: Unit-test every invalid and deprecated enum value through deserialization; require false/error and no arithmetic with a zero block size.
llama_cpp_advisories.action: No candidate backport identified; retain type-fuzz unit coverage without network exposure.
llama_cpp_advisories.label: [MEASURED]

llama_cpp_advisories.title: Legacy GGUF duplicate-key null dereference
llama_cpp_advisories.preconditions: Malformed GGUF with duplicate/inconsistent key metadata reaches the legacy parser.
llama_cpp_advisories.source_status: Requested snapshots use the later C++ parser and postdate the fix; the exact legacy loop is absent.
llama_cpp_advisories.test: Use a bounded GGUF fixture with duplicate keys and a truncated second entry; require parse failure without null dereference.
llama_cpp_advisories.label: [MEASURED]

llama_cpp_advisories.title: Legacy GGUF uninitialized free after short read
llama_cpp_advisories.preconditions: Truncated malicious GGUF causes a short read after an uninitialized pointer array allocation.
llama_cpp_advisories.source_status: Modern requested snapshots use vector/string ownership and avoid the exact allocation/free pattern. The official b2740 tag still shows the legacy malloc/free pattern, so the exact historical remediation commit is unresolved.
llama_cpp_advisories.compile_runtime: Core GGUF parsing in old builds; modern snapshots use rewritten code.
llama_cpp_advisories.test: Under ASan, truncate a bounded string-array fixture after each element and require clean failure with no invalid free.
llama_cpp_advisories.action: No modern backport identified. Keep the historical exact-remediation field open and do not equate the b2740 tag label with source proof.
llama_cpp_advisories.label: [MEASURED]
